description: This file contains implementation of blame functionality in a version control system, including data structures, algorithms for line matching, diff processing, and reference counting for blame origins. It appears to be part of the core blame (annotate) logic handling tracking of line authorship across commits.

classes.name: fingerprint
classes.description: Data structure representing a fingerprint of a text line, supporting comparison and subtraction for similarity detection.

classes.name: fingerprint_entry
classes.description: Data structure for individual byte pair entries within a fingerprint, storing the count of occurrences.

classes.name: line_number_mapping
classes.description: Structure to map line numbers between two diff chunks to preserve order during blame analysis.

classes.name: blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a segment of lines in a file with associated blame information, including the responsible origin.

classes.name: blame_scoreboard
classes.description: Main data structure maintaining blame state, including references to commits, origins, and results.

classes.name: blame_bloom_data
classes.description: Holds Bloom filter keys for blame optimization based on change detection.

classes.name: blame_line_tracker
classes.description: Tracks adjacency and correspondence of lines for heuristic blame rejection in line differencing.

classes.name: handle_split_cb_data
classes.description: Context data used during diff chunk processing to manage blame splitting.
